Title: Family Pension Memorandum 001/1996
Text: Circular on family pension eligibility for spouse and dependent children after death in service or retirement. Circular 001 (1996) clarifies family pension entitlement, service verification, benefit calculation, and dependent claim procedures. Under the state pension directorate rules issued by the finance department, every employee who completed ten years of qualifying service receives a regular monthly pension upon superannuation. A break in service due to unauthorized absence shall not count unless condoned by the competent authority under Rule 27. Dependent parents and unmarried daughters qualify for family pension subject to income ceiling verification and valid service records.
